note: Design table frozen before any data of follow-up 1. Written by the experiment director from classes.json and the seed rules in FOLLOWUP_c32A_m3.md section 4; the iso models are re-verified in Rust by `p2tool spec --focus` (on curve, n*G = O, j equal to curve 80's j) and the spec generator must stop if any value differs.

comparator_rule.rule: Prg('p2-followup1-comparators-c32A-curve80'): i = next() % 128; skip i if i = 80, i in the 8 iso-base indices or already drawn; stop at 7 draws. Prg is p2tool's: next() = u64 little-endian of the first 8 bytes of sha256('<seed>|<counter>'), counter from 0.

iso_rule: Prg('p2-followup1-iso-c32A-80'): for k = 0..7, u_k = 2 + next() % (p - 3); (a,b) -> (u^4 a, u^6 b), G -> (u^2 x, u^3 y), as in `p2tool build` step 6; u_k are 8 distinct values.
fresh_seed_rule: S = (u64 from Prg('p2-followup1-seed-c32A-m3-curve80').next()) mod 10^9 = 363589115; --seed S gives target_seed S and measurement.seed S mod 1000 + 1 = 116 (P2 main cell used 20261102 and 103)
workload_order: primary (index 80), comparators in ascending index, iso models k = 0..7: 24 workloads
